title: The Joined in the app list is barely tested, and never as staff
what: One screen test opens the list as the owner and taps two cards. Nothing checks the empty list words, the card shown when the member app is off, the red line when the list fails to load, the orders and paid lines on a card, the name and +91 number filled into the add form, or anything a staff login sees.
expected: Screen tests for the empty, not-turned-on, failed-load and staff views, and for the filled add form.
fix_line: Add screen tests for each state of the list, as owner and as staff

title: The app invite card on Invite members is never used in a test
what: Screen tests of Invite members only look at the online join link and the demo poster heading. Nobody presses Send on WhatsApp, Copy link or Copy message on the app link card, the blocked-copy words and the gym code card's Copied mark are never checked, and the not-turned-on card for owner and staff is never opened. The message words are checked only as data.
expected: A screen test that presses each share button, checks the notes, and opens the page with the member app off as owner and as staff.
fix_line: Add a screen test for the app invite card and its copy and WhatsApp buttons

title: A desk login can read every sent message by a direct call, and no test checks it
what: The server call that returns the Sent list accepts any signed-in person of the gym, staff included, and gives back each message's title, words and seen count. The staff tests check that staff cannot send or take back a message, but never that they cannot read the list, so this goes unseen.
expected: The Sent list answers the owner only, and a test proves a staff sign-in is refused.
how_often: whenever a staff member calls it directly
fix_line: Make the Sent list owner-only and add the staff refusal to the staff rules test

title: A test requires the desk to read every product, hidden ones and stock numbers included
what: The staff rules test passes only when a staff sign-in can read the whole product list. That list holds hidden products and stock numbers, which the journey says staff must not see. The screen hides the Products tab, but the server gives it all.
expected: Either staff get only what orders need, or the journey is changed to say staff may see stock and hidden products.
how_often: whenever a staff member calls it directly
fix_line: Decide whether staff may see stock and hidden products, then make the test match

title: No server test checks hiding a product, or saving over a member's newer order
what: No database test checks that a hidden product drops out of the member shop, that hiding leaves price and stock alone, that a save made on an older copy is refused so a member's order is not undone, or that old orders keep the item's name after a delete. The panel only sends the version; nothing proves the server refuses an old one.
expected: Database tests for hide, a stale save and a delete with old orders.
fix_line: Add database checks for hide, a stale product save and delete with old orders

title: The message limit warnings are checked only as words, never on screen
what: The one-offer-a-day, three-a-week and ten-a-day lines, the switched-off send button and the red refusal lines are tested only as text returned by code. No screen test opens Messages after an offer went out today and checks the warning and the button.
expected: A screen test where an offer already went today shows the warning and keeps Send in the app off, while WhatsApp still works.
fix_line: Add a screen test for the limit warnings on Messages
